description: Asks what WeekdayName and MonthName return for each index (including 0, past the end, fractional and text), the abbreviate flag at True/False/Null/number, and WeekdayName's first-day argument across -1 to 8; and the VarType of each. Names are locale-dependent and the locale is recorded. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
